I ported the program to Zig in `src/main.zig`, with a standard `build.zig` and a `build.sh` that makes an optimized release build and copies it to `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases, and the unit tests (`zig build test`) pass.

I also tested two 50 MB inputs: one made by the checker's word generator and one of random bytes. On both, the output matched a separate Python reference exactly, and each run took about 0.1 s. Empty input prints nothing and exits with status 0.
